purpose: Independent second-pass PRESS-equivalent review of the 37 evidence-derived logical search families whose term surfaces were revised after frame-1 PRESS review.

review_scope.concepts_complete: Judge the revised domain-term block against direct English term evidence, the search-domain definition, the family label, the prior PRESS defect, and the recorded revision rationale. The revised query must retrieve the intended construct and evidence role without a source-supported omission.
review_scope.boolean_logic_valid: Parentheses, OR blocks, AND relationships, and logical scope must preserve the intended three-block structure.
review_scope.spelling_valid: Terms must contain no accidental spelling error; source-attested historical spellings may remain only when explained.
review_scope.phrases_valid: Multiword phrases and variants must be quoted or grouped appropriately and must not change the source-supported construct.
review_scope.limits_justified: The common publication-date and eligible-work-type filters must match the frozen protocol; English eligibility remains a screening rule so excluded non-English records remain in the denominator.
review_scope.evidence_check: Use term_evidence_json as the authorizing evidence. prior_press_notes and press_revision_rationale explain the defect and repair but cannot independently introduce an unsupported construct.
review_scope.revision_check: Explicitly verify that the previous PRESS defect is resolved and that the repair did not create overbreadth, artificial syntax tokens, or unsupported qualifiers.
review_scope.redundancy_check: Archive only if another active logical query completely covers the same semantics, the current family has no independent construct/evidence role, and the covering query ID is explicit. Result-set subset coverage is recomputed by the pipeline.

decision_rules.pass: All five PRESS checklist fields are true; the prior defect is resolved; covered_by_logical_query_id is blank; independent_construct_role is true; notes state what evidence and repair were checked.
decision_rules.revise: At least one checklist field is false, the prior defect persists, or the repair adds an unsupported concept; notes state the exact remaining defect and an evidence-bounded correction.
decision_rules.archive_redundant: covered_by_logical_query_id names a different active logical query; logical_coverage_verified is true; independent_construct_role is false; notes explain complete semantic coverage. result_set_coverage_verified remains false until pipeline validation.
